title: Derived pullback preserves degreewise pseudo-coherence
statement: Let $h:T\to Y$ be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $m\in\mathbf Z$, and let $K\in D(\mathcal O_Y)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. If $K$ is $m$-pseudo-coherent, in the local strictly perfect approximation sense of [def-sfb-m-pseudo-coherent-complex], then $Lh^*K\in D(\mathcal O_T)$ [def-pc-derived-pullback] is $m$-pseudo-coherent. No flatness of $h$, quasi-coherence of the cohomology of $K$, or Noetherian hypothesis is assumed.

source.place: Tag 09U7, lemma-pseudo-coherent-pullback, restricted from ringed spaces to schemes.

proof.text: Choose an open covering $Y=\bigcup_i V_i$ and maps $\alpha_i:P_i\to K|_{V_i}$ with $P_i$ strictly perfect, cohomology isomorphisms above $m$ and a surjection at $m$, using [def-sfb-m-pseudo-coherent-complex]. Put $U_i=h^{-1}(V_i)$ and $h_i:U_i\to V_i$. The $U_i$ cover $T$. The natural open-restriction comparison [lem-pc-derived-pullback-open-restriction-universes], applied to $h,U_i,V_i$, identifies $(Lh^*K)|_{U_i}$ with $Lh_i^*(K|_{V_i})$.

source.place: Tag 09U7, lemma-pseudo-coherent-pullback, proof; using the derived-category formulation of Tags 08CB and 08CC.

proof.text: Complete $\alpha_i$ to a distinguished triangle $P_i\to K|_{V_i}\to C_i\to P_i[1]$ by TR1 [def-weil-triangulated-category]. In its long exact cohomology sequence [lem-sf-derived-homology-long-exact], the segment $H^j(P_i)\to H^j(K|_{V_i})\to H^j(C_i)\to H^{j+1}(P_i)\to H^{j+1}(K|_{V_i})$ shows $H^j(C_i)=0$ for $j\ge m$: the first map is surjective and the last injective for every such $j$.

source.place: Tag 09U7, lemma-pseudo-coherent-pullback, proof; using the derived-category formulation of Tags 08CB and 08CC.

proof.text: The factorization of $Lh_i^*$ in [def-pc-derived-pullback] is termwise module inverse image followed by derived extension of scalars along $h_i^{-1}\mathcal O_{V_i}\to\mathcal O_{U_i}$. Module inverse image is additive and exact by [lem-pc-inverse-image-module-functor-exact], so its induced functor on derived categories is triangulated by [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated]. The scalar-extension functor is triangulated by clause (2) of [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. The composite therefore sends the triangle of step 2 to a distinguished triangle $Lh_i^*P_i\to Lh_i^*(K|_{V_i})\to Lh_i^*C_i\to (Lh_i^*P_i)[1]$.

source.place: Tag 09U7, lemma-pseudo-coherent-pullback, proof; using the derived-category formulation of Tags 08CB and 08CC.

proof.text: Exact module inverse image [lem-pc-inverse-image-module-functor-exact] and [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-complex-cohomology] give $H^j(h_i^{-1}C_i)\cong h_i^{-1}H^j(C_i)=0$ for $j\ge m$, computed on any representative. Apply clause (a) of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-tensor-cohomological-bounds] on the site of opens of $U_i$, with $R=h_i^{-1}\mathcal O_{V_i}$, $S=\mathcal O_{U_i}$ and $a=m-1$. The factorization [def-pc-derived-pullback] gives $H^j(Lh_i^*C_i)=0$ for $j>m-1$, equivalently for $j\ge m$. The cited bound requires no flatness of $R\to S$.

source.place: Tag 09U7, lemma-pseudo-coherent-pullback, proof; using the derived-category formulation of Tags 08CB and 08CC.

proof.text: The object represented by $P_i$ is perfect, using the one-member covering in [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Thus [lem-pc-derived-pullback-perfect] makes $Lh_i^*P_i$ perfect on $U_i$. By the same definition choose an open covering $U_i=\bigcup_b W_{ib}$ and strictly perfect $Q_{ib}$ with isomorphisms $Q_{ib}\cong(Lh_i^*P_i)|_{W_{ib}}$. Restriction is the exact module restriction in [lem-pc-derived-pullback-open-restriction-universes]; by [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated] it preserves the triangle of step 3, and by [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-complex-cohomology] its third object still has zero cohomology in degrees $\ge m$. Compose the first arrow with the displayed isomorphism to obtain $Q_{ib}\to(Lh_i^*(K|_{V_i}))|_{W_{ib}}$. Naturality of the comparison in step 1 identifies this target with $(Lh^*K)|_{W_{ib}}$.

source.place: Tag 09U7, lemma-pseudo-coherent-pullback, proof; using the derived-category formulation of Tags 08CB and 08CC.

proof.text: For each arrow of step 5, apply [lem-sf-derived-homology-long-exact] to its distinguished triangle. For $j>m$ both adjacent groups $H^{j-1}((Lh_i^*C_i)|_{W_{ib}})$ and $H^j((Lh_i^*C_i)|_{W_{ib}})$ vanish, so $H^j(Q_{ib})\to H^j((Lh^*K)|_{W_{ib}})$ is an isomorphism. At $j=m$ the latter adjacent group vanishes, so this map is surjective. The $W_{ib}$ cover $T$, and these strictly perfect approximations are precisely the witnesses in [def-sfb-m-pseudo-coherent-complex]. Hence $Lh^*K$ is $m$-pseudo-coherent.

source.place: Tag 09U7, lemma-pseudo-coherent-pullback, proof; using the derived-category formulation of Tags 08CB and 08CC.

Step 1: the open-restriction-universes node applies to U_i=h^{-1}V_i (only U ⊆ f^{-1}V is needed) and gives the restriction iso. Step 2: TR1 plus the long exact sequence give H^j(C_i)=0 for j>=m (elementary, checked). Step 3: Lh_i^* = termwise inverse image (exact by lem-pc-inverse-image-module-functor-exact, so triangulated by lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated) followed by change of rings, triangulated by clause (2) of lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings. Step 4: exact inverse image commutes with H^j; lem-weil-pbc-ringed-tensor-cohomological-bounds clause (a) with a=m-1 on the site of opens of U_i needs no Tor or flatness hypothesis, which replaces Stacks' 'dual of 05TC'. Step 5: P_i is perfect, so Lh_i^*P_i is perfect by lem-pc-derived-pullback-perfect, whose closure does not reach the item; the delivery then refines to strictly perfect Q_ib locally, so perfect is never used in place of strictly perfect (C4 avoided). The target identification holds by applying the open-restriction node to (h,W,V_i) and (h_i,W,V_i). Step 6: the reverse long-exact-sequence chase gives iso for j>m and surjection at j=m (checked). Minor point: the identification of the definition's Lj^* restriction with exact restriction is left implicit; it follows in one line from the same node with f=j, so this is a note and not a fault. Edge cases checked: Spec F_2 -> Spec Z with Z/2 = [Z -2-> Z]; Q, which is 1- but not 0-pseudo-coherent; K=0, empty T, negative m, non-quasi-compact T.
